question: Why is std::lower_bound(s.begin(), s.end(), k) on a std::set slow?
option_b: Set iterators are only bidirectional, so the free algorithm takes O(n) steps; the member s.lower_bound(k) is O(log n)
explanation: Always use the member functions on associative containers.
